# Magic Scraper

> A browser extension for Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers that turns the table or list on the page you are viewing into a
> spreadsheet, and a bespoke service for the scrapes that do not fit in a browser.

Every page on this site is also available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`,
or add `.md` to its address, for example https://magicscraper.app/lead-generation.md.

Everything the extension does happens inside the browser. There is no server of ours and no
account. Scraped rows go only where the user sends them: a file, or with Pro their own Google
Sheet or webhook address. The free tier includes
detection, a manual picker, export to CSV/XLSX/JSON, multi-page crawling with no page limit,
and getting back a long run whose tab died part-way. Drill-down -- opening the page behind
every row and merging its fields back in as extra columns -- runs free on the first 3 rows of
a run, and one setup can be run over the first 2 addresses of a list of pages. The paid tier
($25 one-time, $19 for the first 100 buyers) drills every row and chains as many levels deep as
needed, runs one setup over a whole list of pages, saves setups under a name to reuse and
export, compares a run with the previous one of the same list -- or with a CSV, Excel or JSON
file such as a CRM export, marking the rows not in it as new -- and runs a saved setup on a
schedule (every few minutes, every few hours or once a day) while the browser is open. It can
stay open in the browser's side panel beside the page while you click. When a site shows a human-verification check, a run stops
and hands the user the tab; it never tries to get past the check. Stored runs live inside the
extension, not in storage the scraped website can read.

## Magic Snippers

- [Magic Snippers](https://magicscraper.app/magic-snippers): a separate Chrome extension from the
  same maker. It scrapes tables and lists to CSV or JSON, takes whole-page screenshots, and opens
  every link in a list to save a named full-page screenshot of each page, with an index
  spreadsheet. Free, with drill-down on the first 3 links of a run; Pro ($19 one-time, sold on
  Gumroad) drills every link. Everything stays in the browser; the only request it makes is a Pro
  licence check with Gumroad. Privacy: https://magicscraper.app/privacy#snippers

## Product

- [Install free](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/magic-scraper/lcdaikobgjpakcgbkdedoapnckeobbck):
  the Chrome Web Store listing. Installs on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Arc and
  any other Chromium browser.
- [Home](https://magicscraper.app): what the extension does, pricing, and where the data goes
- [Drill-down guide](https://magicscraper.app/drill-down): how to collect a list and the page
  behind every row in one pass, with a worked example on the practice site
- [Business directory scraper](https://magicscraper.app/business-directory-scraper): turning
  every page of a business directory's results into one lead list (name, phone, email,
  address) exported to Excel or CSV; crawling and export are free
- [Chamber of commerce directories](https://magicscraper.app/chamber-of-commerce-directory-scraper):
  a chamber's member directory as a spreadsheet (name, address, city, state, ZIP, phone), with
  each member's website and social pages added from its profile by drill-down
- [Trade show exhibitor lists](https://magicscraper.app/trade-show-exhibitor-list): every
  exhibitor from a show's online list, with details from each exhibitor's profile, to Excel
- [Guides](https://magicscraper.app/guides): every guide, grouped: business lists, spreadsheet
  how-tos, comparisons and the rules
- [Web scraper extension for Microsoft Edge](https://magicscraper.app/web-scraper-extension-for-edge):
  installing from Edge Add-ons, tables over many pages, lists that are not tables, exports
- [Copy a table from a website to Excel](https://magicscraper.app/copy-table-from-website-to-excel):
  keeping the columns, Excel's From Web, Wikipedia tables, Google Sheets IMPORTHTML, tables over
  many pages
- [Web scraper only scraping the first page](https://magicscraper.app/scraper-only-scrapes-first-page):
  why runs stop at page 1 (JavaScript Next buttons, Load more, infinite scroll, rate limits) and
  how to crawl every page free.
- [Scraper doesn't support this site](https://magicscraper.app/scraper-not-working-on-this-site):
  what to try when detection finds nothing, and which sites (LinkedIn, captcha-protected pages) a
  compliant tool should not promise.
- [Scraper missing rows, columns or phone numbers](https://magicscraper.app/scraper-missing-data):
  causes of incomplete data, and Excel leading-zero and UTF-8 problems.
- [Web scraper stops after a few pages](https://magicscraper.app/scraper-stops-after-a-few-pages):
  rate limits, human checks, repeating pages and closed tabs; carrying a crawl on from where it
  stopped, and recovering a run after the tab closed.
- [Scraper columns named x193iq5w or [object Object]](https://magicscraper.app/scraper-column-names-object-object):
  why columns are named after CSS classes, and how Magic Scraper names them from headers, labels
  and value types instead.
- [Scraper blocked, rate-limited or shown a captcha](https://magicscraper.app/web-scraper-blocked-captcha):
  why sites block scrapers, pacing and Retry-After backoff, and why Magic Scraper never solves
  captchas or uses proxies.
- [Scraper popup keeps closing](https://magicscraper.app/scraper-popup-keeps-closing):
  why extension popups close when the page is clicked, and the side panel and (from the next update) own-window modes.
- [Scraped data full of duplicate rows](https://magicscraper.app/scraper-duplicate-rows):
  why crawls collect the same rows repeatedly, how Magic Scraper adds only new rows, and why an
  export can differ from the preview.
- [Send scraped data to your server: Node.js and PHP webhooks](https://magicscraper.app/scraped-data-webhook-node-php):
  the Pro webhook's JSON payload and secret header, complete receivers in Node.js and PHP with no
  packages, and passing rows to a shell script on stdin rather than a command line.
- [Scraping websites in other languages](https://magicscraper.app/scrape-websites-in-other-languages):
  Next buttons in more than 80 languages (from the next update), why Excel garbles accents and kanji
  in a CSV, and European number formats (1.234,56) in the Excel export (next update). The same in
  [Japanese](https://magicscraper.app/scraper-japanese-websites),
  [German](https://magicscraper.app/web-scraper-deutsche-websites),
  [Spanish](https://magicscraper.app/web-scraper-sitios-en-espanol) and
  [French](https://magicscraper.app/web-scraper-sites-francais).
- [A web scraper with no subscription](https://magicscraper.app/web-scraper-no-subscription):
  free tier with no time limit or credits, a one-time Pro licence, and questions to ask before
  paying for any scraper.
- [Is your web scraper extension safe?](https://magicscraper.app/web-scraper-extension-privacy):
  a ten-minute privacy check for any extension, and the requests Magic Scraper makes.
- [Changelog](https://magicscraper.app/changelog): every update in plain words, including anything
  removed or moved between Free and Pro.
- [Feature requests](https://magicscraper.app/requests): ask for a feature and vote on others; shows what
  is open, planned, being built, shipped or declined, with replies.
- [A list of businesses in any area](https://magicscraper.app/list-of-businesses-in-an-area): where
  local business lists live and how to get one into Excel
- [Data Miner alternative](https://magicscraper.app/data-miner-alternative) and
  [Thunderbit alternative](https://magicscraper.app/thunderbit-alternative): honest comparisons
- [Magic Scraper Desktop](https://magicscraper.app/desktop): coming soon for Windows and Linux;
  scheduled monitors with the app closed, saved logins, webhooks, a local API
  ([API docs](https://magicscraper.app/docs/api))
- [Is it legal to scrape a business directory?](https://magicscraper.app/is-it-legal-to-scrape-a-business-directory):
  plain-language guide to site terms, GDPR and the UK/EU/US marketing rules; not legal advice
- [Scrape a list of URLs](https://magicscraper.app/scrape-list-of-urls): one setup run over a
  pasted list of addresses, every page of each, merged into one sheet with a List column (Pro)
- [Scrape a website into Google Sheets](https://magicscraper.app/scrape-website-to-google-sheets):
  IMPORTXML/IMPORTHTML limits, Open in Google Sheets (free), Send to Google Sheets (Pro)
- [Track price changes on a website](https://magicscraper.app/track-website-price-changes):
  scheduled runs, a file per run, and the Changes tab (Pro)
- [Web Scraper (webscraper.io) alternative](https://magicscraper.app/webscraper-io-alternative):
  no sitemap; schedules without a Cloud plan; when webscraper.io is the better fit
- [Ultimate Web Scraper alternative](https://magicscraper.app/ultimate-web-scraper-alternative):
  free exports and a one-time Pro versus yearly plans; when Ultimate does more
- [Lead generation](https://magicscraper.app/lead-generation): building a B2B lead list from public
  directories, chambers, associations and exhibitor lists; keeping only leads not in your CRM
- [Association member directory scraper](https://magicscraper.app/association-member-directory-scraper):
  a trade association or professional body's member list into Excel, A-Z pages and profiles included
- [Instant Data Scraper alternative](https://magicscraper.app/instant-data-scraper-alternative):
  an honest feature comparison. Both tools auto-detect tables and crawl pagination; the
  difference is per-row detail-page collection.
- [Supported sites](https://magicscraper.app/supported-sites): Reddit, Amazon search results,
  Hacker News, PubMed and arXiv read by name into named columns (score, author, price,
  rating, DOI, abstract), page after page; free, no account or API key
- [Support](https://magicscraper.app/support): common problems and their fixes, licence-key
  help, refunds

## Bespoke scraping

- [Services](https://magicscraper.app/services): projects that do not fit inside a browser
  extension — an authorised portal behind a login, a fragile source that fights back, the same
  fields pulled from thirty competitors and reconciled, or a scrape that has to run every
  morning unattended. Quoted per project from the site, the fields, the frequency and the
  budget. Enquiries to support@magicscraper.app.

## Practice site

- [Scrape sandbox](https://magicscraper.app/demo/): a fictional shop built to be scraped.
  Open to anyone, with any tool, and not rate-limited. Eleven pages, each one a different
  problem, and each one states its expected result so a scraper can be checked against it:

  - [Catalogue](https://magicscraper.app/demo/catalogue): a card grid, nine per page, six
    pages of pagination — 54 products
  - [Trade list](https://magicscraper.app/demo/table): a plain HTML table — 50 rows, 7 columns
  - [New arrivals](https://magicscraper.app/demo/scroll): infinite scroll — 8 rows on load,
    40 after five batches
  - [Clearance](https://magicscraper.app/demo/awkward): a discount that applies to every row
    but sits outside the table — 10 rows plus one value no row contains
  - [Shop the look](https://magicscraper.app/demo/shadow): 12 products inside an open shadow
    root, none of them in the light DOM
  - [Stock and delivery](https://magicscraper.app/demo/iframe): a 24-row table inside a
    same-origin iframe, with no table in the parent document
  - Product data (https://magicscraper.app/demo/feed, noindex): 20 products marked up in both
    schema.org JSON-LD and microdata, the two agreeing exactly
  - [Customer reviews](https://magicscraper.app/demo/reviews): a Load more button — 12 on
    load, 48 after three clicks
  - [Warehouse stock](https://magicscraper.app/demo/stock): an ARIA data grid built from divs
    — 30 rows, 6 columns, no table element on the page
  - [Returns log](https://magicscraper.app/demo/returns): deliberately dirty data — 24 rows,
    three date formats, three currency formats, 13 empty cells, 2 exact duplicates
  - [Delivery rates](https://magicscraper.app/demo/rates): two tables of different widths on
    one page — 8 rows and 14

  Behind the catalogue is a ten-level link chain for testing drill-down, running product ->
  maker -> sourcing -> material lot -> supplier -> origin site -> certificate -> certifying
  body -> audit report -> standard. 120 product pages, 8 makers, 8 sourcing pages and 30
  traceability pages, each level holding fields the level above does not. A row costs ten page
  loads, so it is also the place to learn what pacing a run means.

## Optional

- What the extension cannot reach: closed shadow roots, cross-origin iframes, data that only a
  private API returns, PDFs in the browser viewer, and content behind a bot challenge. These
  are limits of the browser, not of the extension.
- Outbound requests: activating a paid licence posts the key to api.gumroad.com once to
  confirm the purchase; with Pro, Send to Google Sheets and Send to webhook send the rows the user
  chose to their own sheet or address. Detection and export make no network requests at all.
  Otherwise the extension requests only the pages the user starts it on: further pages of a list
  during a crawl, the pages rows link to during drill-down, and the addresses in a list of pages.
